subject: Reduce stack friction — sales automation renewal & consolidation plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28 09:12 PDT
Subject: Reduce stack friction — sales automation renewal & consolidation plan

Hey team,

We have both Outreach and Salesloft renewals coming up in December (annuals). Before we get into legal/pricing redlines, I want a pragmatic path that reduces operational friction for AEs and dev effort for integrations. Two options on the table: 1) consolidate to one platform, 2) keep both and simplify syncs + ownership.

Can you each send: a short bullet list of the top three operational pain points from your perspective, any hard integration constraints (SFDC objects, custom fields, webhooks), and the Q3 usage export I attached.

Also: ask both vendors for a migration credit and a clear scope for data porting (sequences, templates, cadence history). I patched together a rough timeline in the attachment (MAP_reduction_plan.xlsx) — feel free to edit.

Propose we meet Tue/Thu next week to align on criteria (cost delta, integration lift, CS impact).

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage_export_q3.csv (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28 10:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Reduce stack friction — sales automation renewal & consolidation plan

Jordan —

Thanks, on it. Quick bullets from field ops:
- Outreach: better sequence analytics, but we see duplicated touches when SFDC sync drops.
- Salesloft: nicer cadence UI and coaching signals, but templates are fragmented across teams.
- Biggest pain: two systems = two sets of templates + inconsistent reporting.

I can pull seat-by-seat usage and top 50 sequences by activity by EOD Friday. Prefer Tue 10/31 10am PT for the sync.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28 13:20 PDT
Subject: Re: Reduce stack friction — sales automation renewal & consolidation plan

Adding some technical constraints so we can scope migration effort: 
- SFDC objects: we have custom OpportunityContactRole fields and a custom object (engagement_metrics__c) populated by Outreach today. Need mapping notes.
- API rate limits: our current webhook mesh throttles at 300 req/min — any migration that spikes calls will require temporary quota increases.
- Encryption/data residency: we need a statement from vendors about where attachment binaries and recording transcripts are stored.

I attached a short sync_matrix.docx with current endpoints and CRON jobs. Will be at Tuesday's meeting.

-Karthik
Principal Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sync_matrix.docx (stub)

From: Sam Greene <sam.greene@outreach.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29 08:30 PDT
Subject: Outreach preliminary quote & migration support

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the heads-up. Outreach can offer a migration credit for seat consolidation and a 12% discount if you commit to a 12-month single-platform agreement covering your current seat count. Attached is a preliminary quote and a one-page migration support summary. Highlights:
- Migration: templates + cadence history export, sequence mapping, and a migration engineer for 40 hours (included).
- SFDC: we support custom object mappings; we'll need the sync_matrix.docx to finalize.
- Data residency: transcripts and recordings can be mirrored to your S3 with AES-256; originals retained per our retention policy unless you request purge.

If you want, I can set up a 30-minute technical call between our integration lead and Karthik on Friday.

Cheers,
Sam Greene
Enterprise Account Executive
Outreach

Attachment: Outreach_prelim_quote.pdf (stub)

From: Nicole Tran <nicole.tran@salesloft.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29 11:00 PDT
Subject: Salesloft migration playbook and credit options

Jordan —

Thanks for including Salesloft. We typically see customers consolidate to Salesloft when coaching/analytics are the priority; we can offer a migration credit and a tailored migration playbook (attached). A few notes:
- We can ingest Outreach sequences and map templates; sequence performance metrics are expected to be best-effort for historical cadence conversion.
- Our Professional Services can include a 20-hour migration sprint and a data reconciliation pass for a fixed fee.
- Links: Migration playbook (attached), API docs: https://developers.salesloft.com/docs

Happy to jump on the technical call with Karthik.

Best,
Nicole Tran
Strategic Accounts
Salesloft

Attachment: Salesloft_migration_playbook.pdf (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Greene <sam.greene@outreach.com>, Nicole Tran <nicole.tran@salesloft.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 15:40 PDT
Subject: Re: Reduce stack friction — sales automation renewal & consolidation plan

Thanks everyone — good movement. Quick summary and proposed mutual action plan: 

1) Technical validation (this week): Karthik + vendor integration leads (Sam/Nicole) — confirm SFDC mappings, API quotas, and attachments residency.
2) Commercials (next week): Marissa + vendors to run seat-level pricing scenarios and migration credits.
3) Exec decision (by 11/15): choose consolidate vs keep dual-vendor and define transition SOW.

Attachments: MAP_reduction_plan.xlsx (updated with timelines) — please add risk items inline.

Action items: 
- Karthik: confirm API quota spike plan and list of fields that must be preserved by 11/3.
- Marissa: compile seat/usage scenarios and target savings threshold.
- Sam/Nicole: share final written migration scope and any limited-time credit offers by 11/5.

I'll loop in Procurement/legal once we have a preferred vendor and an estimated delta. Thanks — feel free to add notes directly to the Drive link.

Jordan
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
